reuseJustification.rule: All22 original complete independent main/mode pages remain individual full images. Dense forms/large windows remain complete readable full-frame jobs. Main pages are not collapsed merely because data looks similar.

Short dialogs/popovers may compare at most3 actual independent local components/widths, with real header/close/body/footer retained where applicable. Full owner chrome is not duplicated into component images.

One component/parent/role per compact matrix; at most7 readable rows. Same-renderer text/data/status/disabled/conditional substitutions map exact source fields/actions/bindings/guards. Protocol-only behavior stays nonvisual.

320/390 comparisons are selected by actual component renderer, owner/guest/standalone role and field/action density. Each source mapping retains exact field order, actions, constraints, scroll/focus/permission contracts and runtime gaps. No mechanical per-source mobile generation.

All19 existing vendor child records have explicit component image sections and exact visible label contracts; a full whiteboard parent never substitutes for them. Shared Sidebar, ColorPicker, SelectedShapeActions and ArrowheadPicker merge only actual common geometry.

Accepted pilot v1 reuses WS-D001 static ready empty desktop only. Existing D003/D006/D007/D008/D009/D019 images retain needs-revision and historical files. They are never promoted by remapping. Missing external source caption alone is not a functional blocker.
